quotes.speaker: Jaren Jackson Jr
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaren Jackson Jr on the importance of consistent off-season work
quotes.excerpt: He makes me want to not waste any time, so I mean I've never worked harder.
quotes.quote: It is definitely a different type of summer, a lot of ways. I could say rebirth, but you know that fellow we did that last summer, every summer can't be rebirth. It really feels like that, but I wouldn't put this in the top three of my favorite summers, just because I lost my friend. But he makes me want to not waste any time, so I mean I've never worked harder.

quotes.speaker: Chris Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Johnson on the necessity of consistency for NBA players
quotes.excerpt: Be consistent in everything you do, even when you don't want to do it.

text_blocks.speaker: Chris Johnson
text_blocks.text: What's the word? What's the word? What's the word of the day?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaren Jackson Jr
text_blocks.text: Oh, I was about to tell you. I know the word. It's about, it's uh, you don't want to get up and work, some people. No, no, no, it's about the people who don't want to get up and work. The people who go work when they don't want to.

text_blocks.speaker: Chris Johnson
text_blocks.text: Consistency. Consistency. Be consistent in everything you do, even when you don't want to do it.

quotes.speaker: Jaren Jackson Jr
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaren Jackson Jr on the necessity of injury recovery and maintenance
quotes.excerpt: Take your injury stuff and your recovery and your strength very serious.
quotes.quote: It's crazy like how many things you really need. You can't just walk out there and just hoop all the time. You actually have to like take care of the small little intricate little things. Not everybody does it though. It's not for everybody. Take your injury stuff and your recovery and your strength very serious. If you don't, it just makes everything harder. The only way to get through anything is just straight through. You just got to go straight through it. Don't try to go around, don't try to do any little cute stuff. Don't do that. You just go straight through it, you know what I mean? If it don't suck, then you ain't doing it right.
